name: Froakie
description: Froakie, the Bubble Frog Pokémon. Able to evolve into Frogadier. A Water type.
pokedex_entries: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.
